exact_inversion.identity: s(q,k)=F(q^-1*k); ordered k codes are q times ordered relative offsets
exact_inversion.restriction: one factor, fixed gain/context condition, distinct scores; no language or query-encoding-cost claim

factorwise_shortlist_counterexample.conclusion: independent fixed factor shortlists do not certify the best additive score

soft_attention_tail_bound.restriction: requires valid upper bounds on all omitted scores; actual scores used to obtain U here; not a sparse-search measurement

limitations: No model was trained or evaluated.
Group relation scoring and threshold search have established antecedents.
Multi-lane access and gain/residual conditions add cost; worst case may inspect all events.
Attention-vector bounds do not prove final-token identity or semantic correctness.
